notes.title: Software Update v1.0.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added
[list]
[*]Graphics API (GAPI) abstraction layer and NULL Render Path.[/*]
[*]Upgraded to BupSystem Core v0.9.6.1.[/*]
[*]Upgraded to JoyFish v0.8.6.1.[/*]
[*]Upgraded to FishClip v0.7.1.0.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Cleanup
[list]
[*]Input assignment procedures can now be aborted by pressing Esc.[/*]
[*]Users now prompted to configure their input assignments on first launch of the program.[/*][/list][/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Software Update v1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Cleanup
[list]
[*]Corrected an issue where Dum Buns couldn’t properly eject themselves from the stage geometry when nudged into it. This was caused by an improper sizing of OID_DUMBUN’s solidity dimensions. [/*][/list][/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Software Update v1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added
[list]
[*][i]Advanced Options[/i] section in HTML Help.[/*]
[*][i]History[/i] section in HTML Help.[/*][/list][/*]
[*]Cleanup
[list]
[*]Corrected an issue where overfeeding a Box Bup could unintentionally reset the software. This was caused by an invalid entry in OID_BOXBUP’s mode table for the BOXBUP_MB_STOP state.[/list][/*]
[/list]
